companyBrief.title: example.com interview preparation
companyBrief.summary: This role is likely centered on frontend engineering with react and ui craftsmanship and typescript and javascript application design. The prep kit focuses on core execution, product judgment, and communication patterns that are often tested in interviews.

kit.roleBreakdown:
The role emphasizes the following themes:
- Frontend engineering with React and UI craftsmanship (must)
- TypeScript and JavaScript application design (must)
- Mentoring juniors and building engineering capability (must)
- Ownership, prioritization, and delivery under ambiguity (must)
